name: setup-manaflow-ai-workbench-look
description: A whole cmux look after a dense code-first agent app with a thread sidebar: a cool neutral dark theme, compact rows grouped by project with their session tree, a monospace-leaning chat in a wide column, prompts as flat rows marked by an accent rule, a square docked message box and the full header. Built only from public surfaces; remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Workbench sidebar" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Workbench's hover card and sidebar rows: the branch and folder up front, regular weight names and a braille spinner while work runs.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1", "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
files.themes/workbench-light.json:
// Workbench Light: the same dense workbench in daylight. A cool off-white page (#f6f7f9), the
// sidebar one step deeper (#eceef2) behind a hairline, blue-gray ink, and the calm blue a step
// deeper (#2f6fd6) so it still marks focus on white.
{
  "name": "Workbench Light",
  "description": "A cool neutral light: off-white, a deeper sidebar, blue-gray ink, one calm blue.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Light",
  // The window, sidebar and pages take that theme too, over an App Theme of your own.
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "colors": { "background": "#f6f7f9", "foreground": "#1d2330", "selection": "#d9e2f0", "accent": "#2f6fd6" },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",
  "ghostty": [
    "background = #f6f7f9",
    "foreground = #1d2330",
    "cursor-color = #2f6fd6",
    "cursor-text = #f6f7f9",
    "selection-background = #d9e2f0",
    "selection-foreground = #1d2330"
  ],

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.fontSmoothing": "antialiased",

  // Layout: flat panes with a hairline between the sidebar and the work, everything tight.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat-sidebar-line",
  "appearance.borders": "default",
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "oneColor",
  "appearance.density": "compact",

  // Proportions: a narrow 232 pt sidebar of 24 pt rows, 12 pt chrome text, a 30 pt tab strip.
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarWidth": 232,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowHeight": 24,
  "appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize": 12,
  "appearance.metrics.tabStripHeight": 30,
  "appearance.metrics.tabFontSize": 12,
  "appearance.metrics.columnGap": 0,
  "appearance.metrics.dividerThickness": 1,

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#eceef2",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "lines",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#f6f7f9",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#eceef2",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.color": "#d5d9e0",
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.opacity": 1,

  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "braille",

  "terminal.fontSize": 12
}
